subject: Procurement & Billing - Invoice requirements and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Procurement & Billing requirements from today's call

Hi Sam — great to meet today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: we discussed expected monthly usage for the initial pilot (~250k tokens), preferred procurement path, and invoice/billing requirements so we can route the commercial paperwork appropriately.

Actions / confirmation needed from Acme procurement: 
- Preferred payment method: PO (Net 30) vs company card?
- Billing address and remit-to (for invoice formatting)
- VAT / tax ID (if applicable)
- Any specific invoice fields needed (PO number, project code, cost center)
- Interest in purchasing via AWS Marketplace (would simplify procurement for many SRE teams)

I've attached a sample invoice and our W-9 to show the typical format we can provide. Monica (billing) and Rishi (sales lead) are cc'd — I'll loop billing for any specific remittance instructions.

Next steps from Redwood: I'll send a formal quote and SOW draft once you confirm the procurement path and billing details; if you prefer PO + Net 30, we'll initiate the credit/vendor setup and share required vendor docs.

If helpful, we can schedule a 15-min vendor onboarding call with your procurement team — what day/time works this week?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0134
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap. A few notes from Acme procurement: 
- We generally prefer PO with Net 30 terms for vendors over $5k/month. That should be fine for the pilot.
- Billing address (for invoice):
  Acme Corporation
  Accounts Payable
  100 Innovation Way
  Palo Alto, CA 94301
- VAT / Tax ID: Acme is US-only; no VAT. Our company tax ID is 12-3456789 if you need it on the invoice.
- Invoice format: PDF is fine; we require a visible PO number and vendor EIN listed. Please include a line item breakdown by month.
- Marketplace: We're interested in AWS Marketplace, but procurement will need to compare pricing/contract flows. Is Redwood already listed?

Can you also provide Redwood's W-9 and vendor legal name for our AP team? I'll start the PO request once we have the quote and W-9.

Appreciate it — Sam

2) Accept Net 30 pending standard vendor/credit setup

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Procurement details from Acme (PO preference, billing address)

Thanks for the ping. Confirming Redwood billing ops can support the following for Acme's pilot: 
- Invoice format: PDF with PO number and line-item monthly breakdown — yes, we can generate this and include vendor EIN. See attached sample invoice.
- Legal / tax docs: Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.; EIN: 98-7654321. W-9 attached.
- Net terms: We can accept Net 30 on a credit-approved basis. For new commercial customers requesting Net 30 we require a brief vendor setup (credit check and signed Master Services Agreement). Timeline for setup is typically 5-7 business days once vendor packet is returned.
- Interim options: customers can start on card/B2B card while vendor setup completes. We can also accept an initial PO with payment on card for the first invoice if that helps ramping.
- Remittance: invoices can be sent to AP email (accounts.payable@acmecorp.com) and we can provide ACH/wire details if needed.

Action items for sales: please confirm if Acme will proceed with PO + Net 30 (we'll kick off vendor setup) or if they'd prefer card to start. Also confirm whether they want Redwood to pursue AWS Marketplace listing for this deal — that would require coordination with partnerships and may change contract terms slightly.

Monica Patel
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
